{{Quote|Who is the Witchblood clan?''"<br />"''You've never heard of them? They live on Dathomir. Been there for centuries. They have their own ideas about how things should work. AND they're Force sensitive.|A pilot and [[Beissa]]|<ref name="SWG:B" />}}
The '''Witchblood Clan''', also spelled '''Witch Blood Clan''', was a clan of [[Witches of Dathomir|Witches]] from the planet [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]].

==Description==
{{Quote|These witches are obsessed with respect. They want everybody who comes to Dathomir to respect them. Whatever! That is their weakness, as far as I'm concerned. I want you to find the clan's burial ground. It's an asteroid base somewhere nearby.|Beissa, to a pilot|<ref name="SWG:B" />}}
Contrary to the majority of the Witches of Dathomir,<ref name="PLCop">''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]''</ref> the Witchblood Clan members manged to avoid being trapped on the surface of Dathomir when the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] established the [[blockade of Dathomir]].<ref name="SWG:DS">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=other|Dathomir system}}</ref> While most of the clan lived on Dathomir,<ref name="SWG:B" /> others had acquired [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and settled other areas of the [[Dathomir system/Legends|Dathomir system]].<ref name="SWG:DS" /> These Witchblood Clan pilots eventually became [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]],<ref name="SWGJtLPOGG" /> flying [[G1-M4-C Dunelizard fighter]]s and [[M12-L Kimogila heavy fighter]]s.<ref name="SWG:PadatWCBG">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=space|Provide a distraction at the Witchblood Clan Burial Grounds|Dathonir system}}</ref>

In Dathomir space, the Witchblood Clan inhabited a region known as the [[Witch Blood Territory]].<ref name="SWG:WBT" /> There, they established their sacred burial ground on an [[asteroid base]].<ref name="SWG:B" /> The clan was also present in other parts of the system such as the [[Dark Force Nebula]], the [[Empire Blockade]] quadrant and near [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]].<ref name="Sony" />

==History==
{{Quote|For now, you need to get the Witchblood clan under control.|Beissa, to a pilot|<ref name="SWG:B" />}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Witchblood Clan was considered the greatest threat in the Dathomir system. The Witchblood fighters prowled the system, attacking both [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] and Imperial starships indiscriminately,<ref name="SWGJtLPOGG" /> as well as civilian vessels.<ref name="Sony" />

After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the hostility of the Witchblood Clan prevented [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] to expand his [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|criminal organization]] in the Dathomir system.<ref name="SWG:B" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> [[Beissa]], the lieutenant of Jabba leading all the Hutt's space operations, designed a show of force to subdue the witches. Beissa ordered [[Talon Karrde]]'s [[Smugglers' Alliance]] pilots to attack the Witchblood sacred burial ground in the Dathomir system.<ref name="SWG:B" /> Using the distraction, the Hutt forces attacked the main Witchblood Clan stronghold in the system. The operation was a success for Beissa as the stronghold was destroyed.<ref name="SWG:PadatWCBG" /> After this humiliation, the Witchblood Clan stopped interfering with Jabba's business.<ref name="SWG:B" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateWitchbloodPirate.png|thumb|right|250px|Possible depictions of Witchblood Clan pilots]]
The Witchblood Clan appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:DS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Witchblood Clan was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]].<ref name="SWG:DS" />
